split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before runtime-corrective owner contract, acceptance suite, generated report, or proof bundle
split_policy.positive_rule: runtime-corrective rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners
split_policy.provenance_rule: generated reports, compile artifacts, replay manifests, module bundles, native-output proof bundles, and linked-probe summaries are provenance until a phase owner claims the behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: fallback, shim, compatibility, old-mode, unsupported, unresolved dispatch, sidecar-only proof, unlinked probes, and alternate acceptance path claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
